mergedParams.userDescription: Words appearing in the distance and flying smoothly past the viewer. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Smooth Flying Text - Typokinetic Titles & Captions

prompts.prompt: Create a 'typokinetics' preset that simulates a cinematic depth-of-field effect where words start as tiny specks in the distance and grow as they fly past the viewer like a sci-fi hyperspace jump. Think of the classic Star Wars opening crawl but with individual words traveling toward the camera at varying speeds. Words should emerge from a vanishing point at the center, initially blurred and small, then rapidly scale up and sharpen as they approach, finally blurring again as they pass by the edges. Use z-axis perspective transforms with aggressive foreshortening. Implement a queue system where words appear in sequence but overlap in motion, creating a constant stream of text flying past. Add subtle rotation on the Y-axis as words pass to enhance the 3D illusion. Consider using different speeds for impactful keywords versus regular words based on caption metadata.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Use BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden perspective-[1000px]' as container. Create child BaseLayouts for each word with 'absolute' positioning. Use TextAtom for rendering words. Effects: Apply generic keyframe effects with translateZ (from -2000px to 500px), scale (0.1 to 3), opacity (0 to 1 to 0), blur (10px to 0px to 5px), and rotateY (-5deg to 5deg). Use 'ease-in' for the approach phase and 'ease-out' for the passing phase. Timing: Stagger word appearances by 0.2-0.4s using relative timing offsets. Total animation per word: 3-4 seconds. Performance: Use 'transform-style: preserve-3d' and 'will-change: transform' in containerProps.style. Caption integration: Access props.captionData.words array, use word.relativeStart for timing, apply faster speeds (shorter duration) for words with impact > 0.7.

prompts.prompt: Design a 'typokinetics' preset inspired by motion graphics where text flows like a river of words across the screen in smooth, wavelike patterns. Picture words surfacing from below the viewport, floating across in serpentine paths, then diving back down - like dolphins breaching and diving. Each word should follow a unique sine wave trajectory with varying amplitude and frequency. Layer multiple streams at different depths using opacity and scale to create parallax. Add a subtle current effect where all words drift slightly in one direction while maintaining their wave patterns. Include gentle rotation that follows the curve of the motion path. Emphasize important words by making them 'jump' higher or glow briefly at their peak.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout wrapper with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. Create 3-4 depth layers as BaseLayout containers with different z-index values. Each word as BaseLayout with 'absolute' positioning containing TextAtom. Effects: Combine translateX (linear drift across screen), translateY (sine wave using custom keyframes at 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%), scale (0.6 to 1.2 based on depth), opacity (0.4 to 1 based on vertical position). For important words (keyword: true in metadata), add a glow effect using textShadow at peak position. Timing: Duration 5-7 seconds per word, staggered starts every 0.3-0.5s. Use 'ease-in-out' for smooth wave motion. Performance: Group words into batches of 5-10 to reduce DOM operations. Use transform for all motion, avoid top/left positioning. Tailwind: 'transform-gpu' for GPU acceleration.

prompts.prompt: Build a 'typokinetics' preset that recreates the feeling of reading text through a train window as landscape rushes by. Words start far on the horizon line (small and compressed), accelerate rapidly as they approach the viewer's position, then streak past with motion blur. Implement realistic perspective where words at the top and bottom of the screen move at different apparent speeds due to viewing angle. Add a subtle vibration/shake effect to simulate the train's movement. Create depth by having some words appear closer (larger, faster) like foreground objects and others further away (smaller, slower) like background scenery. Include atmospheric perspective where distant words are slightly faded and desaturated.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' and perspective. Create horizontal lanes at different Y positions using BaseLayout with 'absolute w-full' positioning. Place words in lanes based on index modulo. Effects: translateX (from 200% to -200%), scale based on lane position (top/bottom smaller), skewX for motion blur effect during fast movement phase, opacity fade at edges. Add small translateY vibration (±2px) with fast frequency. Use blur filter for motion blur: 0px at start, peak 3-5px at center, 0px at end. Timing: Variable duration based on lane - closer lanes 2-3s, distant lanes 4-5s. Use custom easing with slow-fast-slow curve. Caption data: Assign lanes based on word.index, use sentiment for opacity/intensity variations. Performance: Limit to 15-20 visible words maximum, recycle completed animations.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'typokinetics' preset mimicking a vortex or whirlpool effect where words spiral in from the edges of the screen toward a central point before disappearing. Think of it as looking down into a typographic tornado. Words should follow logarithmic spiral paths with increasing angular velocity as they approach the center. Start with slow rotation at the edges, accelerating dramatically near the vortex center. Scale words down as they spiral inward to enhance the depth illusion. Add a subtle color shift or brightness change to simulate the deepening of the vortex. Layer multiple spiral arms for a more complex, dynamic effect. Consider making impactful words briefly 'resist' the pull before being sucked in.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center'. Each word in absolute BaseLayout. Calculate spiral coordinates using polar to Cartesian conversion. Effects: Combine rotate (0deg to 720deg or more), translateX and translateY (following spiral equation), scale (1 to 0.1), opacity (1 to 0). For spiral path: x = r * cos(θ), y = r * sin(θ) where r decreases logarithmically. Add brightness filter fading from 100% to 50%. Timing: 4-6 second total duration, with 'ease-in' acceleration. Stagger word entries by 0.2-0.3s. For high-impact words, add a 0.5s delay mid-animation using keyframe holds. Implementation: Create internal effect preset 'spiral-in' for reusability. Use requestAnimationFrame for smooth polar calculations if needed via helper function.

prompts.prompt: Develop a 'typokinetics' preset that simulates words being typed on an old typewriter and then immediately sliding off the page horizontally, like a continuous feed printer. Each word appears character by character with typewriter-style staccato timing, complete with subtle vertical bounce on each keystroke. Once fully typed, the word slides smoothly to the left while the next word begins typing in its place. Add authentic details: slight rotation variations to simulate imperfect key strikes, random opacity variations for ink consistency, and occasional 'stuck' keys that type slightly slower. Include the mechanical rhythm of a carriage return when moving to a new line position.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-amber-50' for paper background. Create typing zone with BaseLayout 'absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2'. Each word as BaseLayout with TextAtom. Effects: For typing phase - use clipPath or width animation to reveal characters incrementally, add small translateY bounce (-2px) on each character with spring easing. For slide phase - translateX from 0 to -150%, with 'ease-in-out'. Add slight rotate (±0.5deg) and opacity (0.85-1) variations. Timing: Type speed 0.05-0.08s per character, varying by word length. Slide duration 1s. Add 0.2s pause between words. Caption: Use word.text.length to calculate typing duration. Create helper function for character-by-character reveal timing. Performance: Use CSS containment for the typing zone. Tailwind: 'font-mono text-gray-800' for typewriter font.

prompts.prompt: Design a 'typokinetics' preset where words emerge from fog/mist in the distance and rush past like road signs on a highway at night. Start with heavy blur and low opacity to simulate fog, then rapidly clarify as words approach the 'headlight zone' where they become fully visible and bright. As they pass by the sides, they should stretch horizontally (motion blur) and fade back into darkness. Add a subtle glow effect in the headlight zone to simulate illumination. Vary the lateral positions so words don't all follow the same center path - some pass on the left, some on the right, creating a more dynamic scene. Include occasional 'close calls' where words pass very near the viewer with dramatic scaling.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-gray-900 overflow-hidden'. Create fog layers using BaseLayout with gradient overlays. Position words with 'absolute' BaseLayout containing TextAtom with 'text-white'. Effects: Initial state - blur(15px), opacity: 0.1, scale: 0.3. Headlight zone - blur(0px), opacity: 1, scale: 1, add textShadow for glow '0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.8)'. Exit - blur(8px) with scaleX(1.5) for stretch, opacity: 0. Use translateZ for depth, translateX for lateral movement (randomize between -30% to 30%). Timing: 3-4s per word, with 'ease-in' for approach, 'linear' through headlight zone, 'ease-out' for exit. Close calls: 10% of words scale to 2.5 with shorter duration (2s). Caption: Use metadata to determine lane positioning - keywords center lane, others distributed.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'typokinetics' preset that simulates words floating in zero gravity, drifting past like space debris. Each word should have its own trajectory, rotation, and tumbling motion as if floating freely in 3D space. Some words drift slowly and majestically, others spin rapidly. Implement realistic physics where words might gently bump and redirect when paths intersect. Add a subtle parallax effect where words at different 'distances' move at different speeds. Include a gentle light source effect where one side of the words is slightly brighter than the other. Occasionally, a word should drift very close to the camera, going out of focus as it passes.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full bg-black overflow-hidden'. Multiple depth layers as BaseLayout containers. Each word as BaseLayout 'absolute' with TextAtom. Effects: Combine translateX (various speeds -100% to 100%), translateY (slight drift ±20%), rotateX and rotateY (continuous rotation at different speeds), scale for depth (0.5 to 1.5). Add brightness gradient using linear-gradient in style. For close passes: scale to 3, blur from 0 to 10px. Physics: Use sine/cosine functions for smooth directional changes. Timing: Vary duration 8-15s per word for realistic float speeds. Continuous rotation using 'linear' easing, position changes use 'ease-in-out'. Implementation: Create helper function for trajectory calculation. Use internal effect preset 'float-drift' for base motion. Performance: Limit active words to 10-12, queue others.

prompts.prompt: Build a 'typokinetics' preset inspired by particles in a wind tunnel - words start clustered at one side, then get blown across the screen with varying intensities. Some words flutter and tumble chaotically, others glide smoothly. Add turbulence effects where words occasionally spiral or loop unexpectedly. Implement air resistance where smaller words (fewer characters) move faster and more erratically than longer words which are more stable. Create wind gusts that periodically affect all visible words simultaneously. Include a subtle paper-like quality where words slightly bend or warp as they move, as if they were written on light materials being blown by wind.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. Create wind source point at left edge. Words as BaseLayout 'absolute' with TextAtom. Effects: Base motion - translateX (0 to 120%), translateY (sine wave for flutter ±30px). Turbulence - occasional rotate (0 to 360deg) with spring easing, scale wobble (0.9 to 1.1). For wind gusts: add synchronized translateX boost to all visible words. Warping: use skew transforms, alternating skewX and skewY slightly. Timing: Base duration 3-5s, shorter for small words (word.text.length < 5). Gust events every 3-4s affecting all words for 0.5s. Implementation: Create 'wind-gust' internal effect, apply conditionally based on time intervals. Use word.text.length to determine 'weight' affecting motion behavior. Performance: Batch DOM updates during gust events. Tailwind: 'transform-gpu will-change-transform'.

prompts.prompt: Design a 'typokinetics' preset where words materialize as glowing embers rising from the bottom, floating upward past the viewer like sparks from a fire. Each word should flicker with varying intensity, occasionally flaring bright before dimming. Add subtle heat distortion effects making words shimmer and waver. Implement realistic particle physics where words rise faster initially then slow down, with slight random horizontal drift. Some words should burn out completely before reaching the top, while others continue glowing. Create depth by having multiple layers of embers at different distances, with background words smaller and dimmer. Include occasional 'ember bursts' where several words appear simultaneously.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-t from-orange-900 to-gray-900 overflow-hidden'. Three depth layers with different z-index. Words as BaseLayout 'absolute bottom-0' with TextAtom 'text-orange-400'. Effects: translateY (100% to -120%), translateX (sine drift ±15px), opacity flickering (0.4 to 1 randomly), scale pulsing (0.9 to 1.1), color animation (from 'rgb(251,146,60)' to 'rgb(254,215,170)' to 'rgb(156,163,175)'). Heat shimmer: subtle scaleX oscillation (0.98 to 1.02) with high frequency. Glow: textShadow '0 0 10px currentColor'. Timing: Rise duration 4-7s with 'ease-out' deceleration. Flicker using rapid keyframes at 0.1s intervals. Burn out: 20% of words fade to opacity 0 before reaching top. Caption: High-impact words glow brighter, longer duration.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'typokinetics' preset mimicking a slot machine or LED ticker display where words scroll horizontally in multiple parallel tracks at different speeds. Each track should feel like an independent ticker tape with words flowing continuously. Add mechanical snap-to-grid movement rather than smooth scrolling for an authentic digital display feel. Implement occasional synchronization moments where all tracks align briefly to form readable phrases. Include LED-style segmented appearance with subtle scan lines and pixel grid effects. Add power surge effects where all words briefly brighten or flicker. Create the illusion of depth with tracks at different Z positions, front tracks appearing brighter and sharper.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full bg-black overflow-hidden'. Create 3-5 horizontal tracks as BaseLayout 'absolute w-full' at different Y positions. Each word in BaseLayout with TextAtom 'font-mono uppercase'. Effects: Step-based translateX animation using steps() timing function for mechanical movement. LED style: add subtle textShadow glow, use pixelated font. Scan lines: overlay semi-transparent horizontal lines. Brightness variations: opacity 0.7-1 for depth, occasional filter brightness(150%) for surges. Synchronization: calculate LCM of track speeds for alignment timing. Timing: Different speeds per track (2s, 3s, 4s, 6s cycles), use 'steps(20, end)' for ticker motion. Surge events: every 5-6s, all words brightness to 150% for 0.2s. Implementation: Create 'ticker-track' sub-preset for reusable track logic. Performance: Use CSS animations instead of JS for smooth stepping. Tailwind: 'text-green-400 selection:bg-green-900' for LED aesthetic.
